req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-026 requires HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. The endpoint supports GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH, HEAD (as a method-check), OPTIONS (framework-dependent). Tests cover: (1) positive — supported method GET returns 200, confirming the endpoint is live and method-routing works; (2) negative — POST to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405; (3) boundary — PATCH to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405; (4) decision-table — multiple unsupported methods all return exactly 405; (5) NEG — verifying the 405 body contains the 'detail' or 'method' indicator. Mutation resilience: exact status code 405 asserted (catches 404/400/500 mutations), exact 200/204 for supported methods (catches off-by-one on status), both sides of the method-routing decision tested.

tests.name: test_supported_get_method_returns_200
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Task with id=1 exists in the pre-loaded database
expected: Response body contains id=1 and title='Read chapter 5'
trace: R-TASK-026: supported method must NOT return 405
Catches mutations that flip the 405 guard to also reject GET
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_supported_get_method_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 1
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert body["completed"] == True

test_supported_get_method_returns_200()

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_to_task_id_returns_405():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "New Task", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/1", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 404

test_post_to_task_id_returns_405()

tests.name: test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Task with id=3 exists in the pre-loaded database
actions: Send POST, PATCH to /tasks/3 and assert each returns 405
Send GET, PUT, DELETE to /tasks/3 and assert each does NOT return 405
trace: R-TASK-026: decision table covering all method branches
Catches mutations that flip method routing logic or status constants
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/3", json={"title": "X", "completed": False})
    assert r_post.status_code == 405
    r_patch = client.patch("/tasks/3", json={"completed": False})
    assert r_patch.status_code == 405
    r_get = client.get("/tasks/3")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    r_put = client.put("/tasks/3", json={"title": "Submit expense report", "completed": True})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    r_del = client.delete("/tasks/3")
    assert r_del.status_code == 204

test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405()

tests.name: test_unsupported_method_on_nonexistent_task_still_405
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Task with id=9999 does NOT exist in the pre-loaded database
expected: HTTP 405, not 404 — method check precedes resource existence check
trace: R-TASK-026: boundary — method rejection must occur even when resource is absent
Catches mutations that reorder 404 vs 405 checks or short-circuit on missing resource

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_unsupported_method_on_nonexistent_task_still_405():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/tasks/9999", json={"title": "Ghost", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 500

test_unsupported_method_on_nonexistent_task_still_405()
